question: Which AI regulatory instrument best reduces expected harm from frontier AI over the next five years, keeping the technology sector's net loss below $400bn and the gross social cost under $150bn?

rows.label: Six month moratorium above the threshold

note: each seed is an independent run of the same fixed size; coverage is the share of seeds whose 95% interval contains the mean of the other seeds; the intervals of one alternative's quantities across seeds are independent, those of different alternatives within a seed are not, so the overall coverage is descriptive
